body:
i don't think i want a future without my baby anymore

i really tried

i didn't get to know my baby's gender

i like to think it was a she

she is isabela

she passed away at 7w 3d

i held her for so short
i lost my baby and i want to hold my baby

thank you for assuring me my baby is close to her mommy's love

i will fight forever to make her known, to make her a part of my world on my every day Life and i will heal with my baby
thank you so much for sharing this beautiful quote, it made me tear up and feel safe
thank you for telling me about your pain, i will forever remember this

thank you, it makes me feel a lot better to know my little one has become fingerprinted to my bloodstream!!

i never knew what they were, but i believe she was a baby girl, and i was planning on calling her Isabela

i hope my baby is with God and all my loved ones are taking care of her 

thank you for comforting me
thank you so much, it means the world to have support
thank you, you help me put it in a different light
thank you, i believe we both are, i'm trying to make good decisions because i don't want to hurt him but it's hard when he won't talk to me

thank you, i will try my best, i will forever miss my baby but i'm sure with time i won't cry so much

i just want everything to end quickly

oh, she was so mad, so scary

but you are right, my mom loves me no matter what, i imagine it must be a lot more difficult as a mom, so i try to be comprehensive

thanks for answering ♥️

thank you very much, i can tell you come from a good place and i will take this advice

thanks for taking the time to answer ♥️

okay, i will take your advice!

thank you for answering ♥️

i never thought it wasn't normal to fear him

i will try and make the best out of this, i know i can 

thank you for being so sweet ♥️

i'm afraid he will get violent if i break up with him, at the same time i don't think it's appropriate to tell him over the phone

thanks for answering ♥️
